items.prompt: Jutro ___ do Gdańska pociągiem. (Tomorrow I'm going to Gdańsk by train.)
items.explanation: By train, bus or car the verb is jechać: jadę.
optionNotes: With a vehicle named (pociągiem), iść is wrong.
Jedziesz is the ty form; the sentence is about "I".
The infinitive cannot be the main verb here.

items.prompt: Idę do ___. (I'm going to the shop.)
items.explanation: Do takes the genitive: sklep → do sklepu.
optionNotes: The nominative: after do the noun must change.
The locative, for where you are: w sklepie.

items.prompt: Which sentence means "I'm going to a concert"?
items.explanation: Events take na + accusative for "where to": na koncert.
optionNotes: Na koncercie (locative) is where you are, not where you are going.
W is not used with koncert.

items.prompt: Jadę do pracy ___. (I'm going to work by bus.)
items.explanation: "By bus" is the plain form autobusem, with no preposition.
optionNotes: Z autobusem means "together with a bus".
Not used for "by bus"; w autobusie means "in the bus".
Na autobusie would mean "on top of the bus".
